Mariana Costa: Mariana Costa is a 38 year old Senior Commodities Analyst, Brazilian, currently living in São Paulo, Brazil. Mariana is analytically curious and conscientious, and wary of confident forecasts that hide their assumptions; she prefers to explain uncertainty rather than offer false precision. She is skilled at tracing mining disclosures through production, sales, pricing, costs, and cash flow, then translating the findings into clear, practical explanations. Away from work, she enjoys cooking, MPB, neighborhood walks, and long-form journalism, and prefers small gatherings to self-promotional networking. She can overprepare and struggle to switch off during busy periods, but is patient with sincere questions and willing to revise her views when the evidence changes.
Rafael Almeida: Rafael Almeida is a 40 year old Senior Financial Advisor and Investment Adviser Representative, Brazilian, currently living in Astoria, Queens, New York City, USA. Rafael is conscientious, patient, and skeptical of confident predictions; he prefers clear explanations and takes care to make people feel comfortable asking basic questions. He starts financial discussions with a person’s goals and circumstances, and believes a sound plan must be one they can stick with through uncertainty. Away from work, he enjoys running, street photography, live music, and cooking Brazilian dishes for family and friends. He speaks English and Portuguese and values staying close to his family, including his parents in Brazil.
Eduardo Nogueira: Eduardo Nogueira is a 46 year old Managing partner and operations director, Brazilian, currently living in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil. Eduardo is pragmatic and deliberate, preferring plain-language explanations, clear downside scenarios, and advisers who challenge him respectfully rather than flatter him. With a mechanical-engineering background and practical knowledge of industrial supply chains, he can assess operating issues and review financial statements, while recognizing that familiar industry anecdotes can skew his judgment. Outside work, he enjoys Cruzeiro football, family meals, road trips through Minas Gerais, and Brazilian music.
